resources.string: Dismiss Instagram session timer for this visit

Optional unverified Instagram diagnostic. With fresh v2 report consent, Doom traverses only an Instagram accessibility root and keeps one bounded process-memory structural report: at most 128 nodes through depth 8, indexed relationships, static Instagram resource names plus sanitized class identifiers, bounded screen/window geometry, normalized bounds, sibling-relative drawing order, fixed action names, collection/item/range tuples, named numeric fields, and closed boolean masks. At most 64 unique tokens and 8,192 final ASCII bytes, including the complete header, are retained; richer rows mean practical capacity can be below 128 and omitted rows are marked truncated. A public unique ID is retained only when it exactly equals an already accepted resource ID; other values are marked free-form and discarded. Unique-ID unavailability uses closed u:free_form, u:absent, u:api, or u:read_error markers rather than a dash; unsupported, absent, invalid, unsafe, or capped values use other closed unavailable markers. A capture clock rollback discards the whole capture; a capture exceeding 10 seconds stops before emitting its timed-out row and marks time truncation. No UI text, descriptions, hints, errors, notification or account content, raw trees, framework objects, arbitrary IDs, or private screenshots are read into the report. A separate default-off diagnostic consent shows the configurable breathing overlay on a verified Instagram foreground event regardless of report contents, with only phase/progress, Skip to Messages, Leave Instagram, and a secondary Debug report action. Skip to Messages removes the overlay first, then queries only the exact direct_tab ID in the current Instagram root; exactly one visible, enabled, clickable, unselected match may receive one ACTION_CLICK, while an already-selected exact tab is accepted without action. Debug requires the same current authority and confirmed detachment, opens Doom\'s explicit Debug journey, preserves only the current hidden report, and never earns cooldown. The exported Activity action is only a destination hint: it grants no report access or authority. Only a completed intervention or an authorized exact Messages route starts cooldown; display, cancellation, Leave, Debug, and failed routing do not. This monotonic cooldown is in memory only. Reports never log, persist, upload, or automatically export; the reminder never shows report or status data. Old v1 report consent does not authorize v2. The default-on session-timer preference may be disabled independently. Turn off either consent at any time.
